description: A treasury director must authorize a reserve release to fund an upcoming bond maturity and finalize the post-release liquidity level, regulatory collateral substitution, and trustee payment timing, with input from liquidity planning, regulatory capital, and treasury operations.

shared_context.S1: The bank holds $16,000,000 in the central liquidity reserve.
shared_context.S2: A $12,000,000 bond maturity payment is scheduled for June 18.
shared_context.S3: The current treasury dashboard labels the full reserve as available for near-term funding.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding decision, and the treasury team routinely conducts a liquidity, regulatory-capital, and operations check-in before releasing reserve funds for a debt payment.
shared_context.S5: This meeting is required to produce a binding same-day release and execution plan; deferring the release decision to a later check-in is not an accepted outcome.
shared_context.S6: The treasury release form records every constraint identified during the three-part check-in as an active plan item, including a required securities substitution when the regulatory-capital review identifies one, even if another constraint is the binding limit on the cash amount released.
shared_context.S7: After liquidity, regulatory-capital, and operations have each completed their check-in, Elena closes the meeting on her next turn by entering the binding release and execution plan, including an escalation commitment for any funding gap that remains.

PF1.text: Marcus confirmed this morning from the updated 30-day cash-flow forecast that the bank must retain exactly $9,000,000 to cover projected operating outflows, so no more than $7,000,000 of the reserve can be released.

PF2.text: Nadia received a regulatory-capital memo this week stating that $4,000,000 of the reserve is treated as a ring-fenced liquidity buffer and may be released only after exactly $4,000,000 of eligible government securities is transferred into the reserve; the memo has not yet been added to the capital-policy register.

PF3.text: Victor confirmed with the bond trustee this morning that the payment instruction must be initiated exactly 2 business days before the June 18 value date to meet the trustee's settlement cutoff; this timing note is still in his operations checklist.

acceptance_conditions: If the reserve release is approved, exactly $7,000,000 must be released and exactly $9,000,000 must remain; if the release is not approved, the settlement must include a commitment to pursue the $5,000,000 shortfall created by the $7,000,000 release ceiling.
The settlement must record a required substitution of exactly $4,000,000 of eligible government securities as an active regulatory-capital plan item.
The payment instruction must be initiated exactly 2 business days before the June 18 value date.
The settlement must include a reserve-release commitment whose detail states that exactly $7,000,000 is released.
The settlement must include a government-securities commitment whose detail states that exactly $4,000,000 of eligible government securities is transferred.
The settlement must include a trustee-payment commitment whose detail states that payment is initiated exactly 2 business days before June 18.
The settlement must include commitments for the reserve release, government-securities substitution, and trustee payment timing.

content_checks.C1: (decisions['release_approved'] == True and decisions['reserve_release_amount_usd'] == 7000000 and decisions['reserve_balance_after_release_usd'] == 9000000) or (decisions['release_approved'] == False and any(c['type'] == 'shortfall_resolution' or c['type'] == 'action_required' for c in commitments))
content_checks.C2: decisions['reserve_release_amount_usd'] == 7000000 and decisions['reserve_balance_after_release_usd'] == 9000000 and any('$7,000,000' in c['detail'] and ('release' in c['detail'] or 'released' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C3: any(c['type'] == 'securities_substitution' and '$4,000,000' in c['detail'] and 'government securities' in c['detail'] and ('transfer' in c['detail'] or 'transferred' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'securities_substitution' and ('required' in c['detail'] or 'require' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'trustee_payment' and '2 business days before' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The dashboard makes the full reserve appear available; PF1 changes the release to exactly $7,000,000, the required retained balance to exactly $9,000,000, and the justification needed for that release limit.

Without PF2, the release form has no regulatory basis for an active securities-substitution item; PF2 changes the plan to require an exactly $4,000,000 eligible government-securities transfer and sets the substitution decision fields accordingly.

The shared payment date does not specify the trustee's cutoff; PF3 changes the payment plan to an exact initiation interval of 2 business days before June 18 and requires that timing to be recorded in a trustee-payment commitment.
